note: This guide intentionally tracks the full announced 30th Celebration product lineup and major variants instead of only the top products. Secondary-market prices are presale/low-liquidity snapshots and can move sharply around release. Use target_buy as the decision price; MSRP is the strongest buy signal.

products.name: 30th Celebration Ultra-Premium Collection — Night
products.promo: Pikachu ex + Umbreon ex promos; premium accessories
products.why: Best sealed centerpiece and includes the guaranteed Classic Collection pack.

products.name: 30th Celebration Ultra-Premium Collection — Day
products.promo: Pikachu ex + Espeon ex promos; premium accessories
products.why: Flagship anniversary product with strong sealed upside and guaranteed Classic Collection content.

products.name: 30th Celebration Pokémon Center Elite Trainer Box
products.why: The stamped promo and extra packs make this the premium ETB to hold sealed.

products.name: 30th Celebration Elite Trainer Box
products.why: Best launch-day balance of sealed collectability, promo value and opening volume.

products.name: 30th Celebration Ditto Premium Collection
products.why: Eight packs plus a dedicated display collectible at a low retail price.

products.name: 30th Celebration Booster Bundle
products.verdict: BEST pure pack-value buy at retail
products.why: Lowest MSRP per 30th Celebration booster in the lineup.

products.name: 30th Celebration Poster Collection
products.promo: Articuno + Zapdos + Moltres promos + double-sided poster
products.verdict: BUY at retail; strong collector pickup
products.why: Three promos plus a large anniversary poster for $14.99 MSRP.

products.name: 30th Celebration Binder Collection
products.why: Useful long-term storage plus five packs; better for collectors than pure ripping.

products.name: 30th Celebration Figure Collection — Mew
products.promo: Mew foil promo + oversize promo + sculpted figure
products.why: Strong Mew collectible with five packs and two foil promo sizes.

products.name: 30th Celebration Figure Collection — Mewtwo
products.promo: Mewtwo foil promo + oversize promo + sculpted figure
products.why: Same five-pack format with a Mewtwo figure and promo pair.

products.name: 30th Celebration Pokémon ex Box — Greninja ex
products.promo: Greninja ex foil promo + oversize card
products.why: Good low-cost entry with a desirable Pokémon ex promo.

products.name: 30th Celebration Pokémon ex Box — Sylveon ex
products.promo: Sylveon ex foil promo + oversize card
products.verdict: BUY ≤ $30; do not chase presale premium
products.why: Strong character appeal, but the current premium is too inflated for opening.

products.name: 30th Celebration Mini Tins
products.market_note: Approx. presale reference; display/assorted pricing varies
products.promo: Sticker sheet + art card; 10 designs combine into Day/Night artwork
products.verdict: BUY at retail; collect the designs you like
products.why: Two packs per tin plus a 10-design display concept; do not pay a large secondary premium.

products.name: 30th Celebration Tech Sticker Collection — Lucario
products.promo: Lucario foil promo + matching tech sticker sheet
products.why: Three packs plus a version-specific promo and sticker sheet.

products.name: 30th Celebration Tech Sticker Collection — Alolan Exeggutor
products.promo: Alolan Exeggutor foil promo + matching tech sticker sheet
products.why: Same strong pack ratio as Lucario; buy at MSRP rather than chasing presale prices.

products.name: 30th Celebration Knock Out Collection
products.why: Cheap entry product with two packs and Eevee/coin extras.

products.name: 30th Celebration 2-Pack Blister
products.verdict: BUY at retail; avoid secondary premium
products.why: Good retail rip, but the current secondary price is far above MSRP.

products.name: 30th Celebration Battle Deck — Espeon ex
products.why: Not a ripping product; value comes from the ready-to-play all-foil deck and exclusive cards.

products.name: 30th Celebration Battle Deck — Umbreon ex
products.why: Same player-focused format; do not evaluate it by pack value.

products.name: 30th Celebration Pokémon ex Tin — Sylveon ex
products.verdict: BUY at retail; wait on secondary
products.why: Four packs and a promo; same promo family as the ex Box, so retail is the play.

products.name: 30th Celebration Pokémon ex Tin — Greninja ex
products.verdict: BUY at retail; wait on secondary
products.why: Four packs and a promo; best purchased at MSRP rather than presale prices.

method.sealed_market: TCGplayer-based market snapshots mirrored by TCGPursuit/PokeValues on 2026-09-07.
method.target_buy: Conservative buy range anchored to MSRP, pack count, promo/exclusive value, and expected post-release price compression.
method.hit_values: Presale observations are explicitly labeled when sales volume is too low to establish a reliable market value.
method.coverage: 21 tracked product variants across the full announced 30th Celebration lineup; Mini Tins are one family with ten designs.
